# Refusal-Direction Model Utilities

These files add the model wrappers used for this project to the external `refusal_direction` implementation of `Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction`.

Copy the files in this directory into a checkout of that repository at:

```text
refusal_direction/pipeline/model_utils/
```

The copied `model_factory.py` recognizes the model families used here: Llama 2, Llama 3, Llama 3.2, Vicuna, Qwen 1.8B, Qwen 2.5, Phi 3.
